terbaru.judul: Adaptive Dueling Double Deep Q-networks in Uniswap V3 Replication and Extension with Mamba
terbaru.pelajaran: The report goes through the main steps of replicating and improving the article "Adaptive Liquidity Provision in Uniswap V3 with Deep Reinforcement Learning." The replication part includes how to obtain data from the Uniswap Subgraph, details of the implementation, and comments on the results.

terbaru.judul: Cryptocurrency Portfolio Management with Reinforcement Learning: Soft Actor--Critic and Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient Algorithms
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning--based framework for cryptocurrency portfolio management using the Soft Actor--Critic (SAC) and Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithms.

terbaru.judul: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Automated Stock Trading: An Ensemble Strategy
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose an ensemble strategy that employs deep reinforcement schemes to learn a stock trading strategy by maximizing investment return.

terbaru.judul: Risk-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Portfolio Optimization
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for dynamic portfolio optimization under market uncertainty and risk.

terbaru.judul: Deep reinforcement learning for optimal trading with partial information
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper we study an optimal trading problem, where a trading signal follows an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with regime-switching dynamics.

terbaru.judul: Application of Deep Reinforcement Learning to At-the-Money S&P 500 Options Hedging
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper explores the application of deep Q-learning to hedging at-the-money options on the S\&P~500 index.

terbaru.judul: Diffusion-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Robust Portfolio Optimization under Stress Scenarios
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this, we propose an innovative framework, termed Diffusion-Augmented Reinforcement Learning (DARL), which synergistically integrates Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for portfolio management.

terbaru.judul: DeepAries: Adaptive Rebalancing Interval Selection for Enhanced Portfolio Selection
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose DeepAries , a novel deep reinforcement learning framework for dynamic portfolio management that jointly optimizes the timing and allocation of rebalancing decisions.

terbaru.judul: AlphaX: An AI-Based Value Investing Strategy for the Brazilian Stock Market
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we propose an AI-based strategy inspired by a classical investment paradigm: Value Investing.

terbaru.judul: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Asset Allocation Using DDPG with TiDE
terbaru.pelajaran: To overcome these constraints, this study formulates the optimal two-asset allocation problem as a sequential decision-making task within a Markov Decision Process (MDP).
